描述_EN: the painted decoration depicts a dragon spouting a fish. the bottle does not have a separate foot, but there is a high glazed indentation underneath with a four-character yongzheng (1723-35) mark in regular script in red, the foot edge unglazed. the bottle is an elongated ovoid form without a stopper. it is made of porcelain, painted in black and green.
描述_ZN: 的绘画装饰描绘了一条龙在喷鱼。 该瓶没有独立的底，但是下面有一个高的釉面压痕，上面有红色的四字雍正（1723-35）楷书款，底边没有上釉。 该瓶是一个细长的卵圆形，没有塞子。 它是由瓷器制成的，涂有黑色和绿色。
